phase_read: Acute phase — most signals still deteriorating. Historically not a phase to be deploying capital; hold dry powder.

signals.name: Retail diesel price ($/gal, weekly)
signals.watch_for: Watch for the price to stop making new highs and start correcting — that's the signal demand destruction is working, not the absolute level.

signals.name: WTI crude oil ($/bbl, daily)
signals.watch_for: Same idea as diesel: a peak-and-roll-over pattern, not a specific price target.

signals.name: High-yield credit spread (%, daily)
signals.watch_for: One of the best leading indicators historically — spreads often peak and start narrowing weeks to months before stocks bottom.

signals.name: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread (%, daily)
signals.watch_for: Watch for re-steepening after inversion (short rates falling faster than long rates as the Fed cuts) — this has historically coincided with equity bottoms.

signals.name: Initial jobless claims (weekly)
signals.watch_for: Watch for claims to plateau and roll over, not necessarily fall in absolute terms yet — the deceleration itself is the signal.

signals.name: VIX volatility index (daily)
signals.watch_for: Elevated and rising = still in the acute/capitulation phase. Elevated but falling = fear is draining out.
